an4.234:1.1: athakho sikhāmoggallāno brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.234:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sikhāmoggallāno brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.234:2.1: purimāni bho gotama divasāni purimatarāni soṇakāyano māṇavo yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavoca
an4.234:2.2: samaṇo gotamo sabbakammānaṃ akiriyaṃ paññāpeti sabbakammānaṃ kho pana akiriyaṃ paññāpento ucchedaṃ āha lokassa
an4.234:3.1: dassanaṃpi kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa soṇakāyanassa māṇavassa nābhijānāmi
an4.234:3.3: cattārīmāni brāhmaṇa kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni
an4.234:3.7: atthi brāhmaṇa kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.234:3.8: atthi brāhmaṇa kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.234:4.2: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti
an4.234:4.3: so sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an4.234:4.4: tamenaṃ sabyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhā phassā phusanti
an4.234:4.5: so sabyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyati ekantadukkhaṃ seyyathāpi sattā nerayikā
an4.234:4.6: idaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
an4.234:5.2: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti abyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti abyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti
an4.234:5.3: so abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an4.234:5.4: tamenaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ abyāpajjhā phassā phusanti
an4.234:5.5: so abyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno abyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyati ekantasukhaṃ seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā
an4.234:5.6: idaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ.
an4.234:6.1: katamañca brāhmaṇa kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.234:6.2: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti
an4.234:6.3: so sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi lokaṃ upapajjati
an4.234:6.4: tamenaṃ sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhāpi abyāpajjhāpi phassā phusanti
an4.234:6.5: so sabyāpajjhehipi abyāpajjhehipi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi vedanaṃ vediyati vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṃ seyyathāpi manussāekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā
an4.234:6.6: idaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ.
an4.234:7.1: katamañca brāhmaṇa kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati
an4.234:7.2: tatra brāhmaṇa yampīdaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā yampīdaṃ kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā yampīdaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā
an4.234:7.3: idaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.234:7.4: imāni kho brāhmaṇa cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
